change.name: assistant_runtime_thread_projection_insert
preconditions: SELECT to_regclass('assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections') IS NOT NULL AND has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'runtime','assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections','SELECT') AND has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'runtime','assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections','UPDATE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'runtime','assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections','INSERT')
postconditions: SELECT NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'runtime','assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections','DELETE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'runtime','assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections','TRUNCATE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'runtime','assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections','REFERENCES') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'runtime','assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections','TRIGGER')

SELECT count(*)=1 FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) a WHERE c.oid='assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections'::regclass AND pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)=left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'runtime' AND a.grantor=c.relowner AND a.privilege_type='INSERT' AND NOT a.is_grantable
change.notes: Candidate 022 grants only INSERT on assistant.assistant_runtime_thread_projections to the owner-prefix runtime role. The normal create_thread path already has required rights elsewhere; root review and isolated own-role rollback probe are required before activation.
